items.evidence: Seed 1, bot script to tick 5200 then 'none', run to 5600: wave 6, 5 walkers all kind runner, health 1, x 0.95/5.45/9.95/14.45/18.95 (4.5 apart = 3 u/s x 1.5 s; first moved 19.05 in 381 ticks = 3 u/s). Full win run: score 450 after wave 5 -> 675, i.e. 15 runners x 15 with gate 5.

HUD 'Wave N of 6' / 'Oleada 1 de 6' / 'Vague 1 sur 6'. At tick 5150 all of wave 5 destroyed (score 450, no walkers) and screen still play; tick 6580 screen won, score 675, texts [You won, Score: 675, Enter: title]. Stopping fire at 6380: two runners passed the gate -> gate 3, screen won, score 645.

Right on Language: es -> fr -> en. French texts: title [Défends la porte, Commencer, Réglages, Quitter]; settings [Réglages, Volume : 5, Langue : Français, Difficulté : Facile/Normal/Difficile, Retour]; play [Score : 10, Vague 1 sur 6, Porte : 5]; paused [En pause, Reprendre, Titre]; won [Vous avez gagné, Score : 675, Entrée : titre]; lost [Vous avez perdu, Score : 0, Entrée : titre]. The frames show the same text.

Settings texts [Settings, Volume: 5, Language: English, Difficulty: Normal, Back] (fresh settings: Normal). On Difficulty (menu_index 2) Right -> Hard, Right again stays Hard, Left -> Easy, Left again stays Easy. Spanish shows Dificultad: Fácil/Difícil, French shows Difficulté : Facile/Difficile. The frame marks the focused Difficulty button.
Seed 3 tick 400: Easy walkers health 1, Hard walkers health 3, Normal walkers 2 (seed 1). Wave 6 samples (bot then idle): Normal runners 1, Easy runners 1 (tick 5330), Hard runners 2 (tick 5700).

After setting Hard (or Easy) a second run in the same settings folder starts with difficulty hard (or easy); the settings file is {volume, language, difficulty}. An old file {"volume": 7, "language": "es"} loads volume 7, es, difficulty normal, even though the engine was on Hard just before.
Every printed state has 'difficulty' and walkers have 'kind' ('walker' or 'runner'). All 17 frames I wrote are PNGs with an 800x480 header.
All 18 items that passed before still pass (m01-m13, m15-m19; see below). m14 failed before and was not tested again.

CHANGES.md lists each change with its files (lib.rs, fr.json, game.json, settings.json, headless.py, checks), says what was checked and how (run_checks.py, 20 checks) and what was not, and lists what was wrong before.

defects: checks/run_checks.py writes its scratch into work/.scratch, inside the game folder (I did not run it for that reason).
From reading tools/headless.py (not run): Left on Language sends the same cycle:language action as Right, so Left steps forward instead of back.
Pause/Resume still lets the engine clock run on after Resume (m14 from before), unchanged by this work.
README's 'Add a language' list starts with a step 0 that refers to things explained only later; minor.
l10n_check theme contrast error in assets/ui/theme.json (reported by the builder; not seen on any screen).

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
